description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment, Lakshapathiya,  Moratuwa D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520210
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It specifically addresses the amendment/expungement of title particulars for specific parcels of land (including cadastral map numbers, block numbers, village locations, and administrative divisions). The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and is issued by the Commissioner of Title Settlement from the Land Title Settlement Department, making it clearly focused on land and property-related administrative matters.
